list.title: Sessions
list.subtitle: Conversation sessions with extracted memory · {name}
list.guideBody: Sessions are conversation threads between users and AI agents. Each session captures the full dialog, extracted facts, classifications, and structured data — building persistent memory for your applications.
list.emptyDescription: Create a session to start extracting memory and knowledge.
list.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete session "{id}"? All associated messages, facts, and extracted data will be permanently removed.
list.externalIdHint: A unique identifier for this session within the project.

detail.guideBody: View all data for a single session: messages, extracted facts, graph relationships, classifications, and structured extractions. Each tab shows a different aspect of the processed conversation.
detail.selectTab: Select a tab above to view session data.
detail.selectTabHint: Messages, facts, graph, classifications, extractions, and observations.

messages.title: Messages
messages.subtitle: Conversation messages for this session
messages.noProjectDescription: Select a project to view messages.
messages.guideBody: Browse all messages in this session in chronological order. Messages are the raw input that the enrichment pipeline processes to extract entities, facts, classifications, and structured data.
messages.emptyTitle: No messages in this session yet
messages.emptyDescription: Messages will appear once the conversation starts.

facts.guideBody: Facts are discrete pieces of information extracted from conversation messages — statements, attributes, and relationships about entities. Each fact is verified and stored in the knowledge graph.
facts.emptyDescription: Facts will appear here once the session is processed.

classifications.guideBody: Classifications categorize each conversation turn by intent, topic, sentiment, and priority. They provide structured labels that help organize and route conversations.
classifications.emptyDescription: Classification data will appear here once processed.

extractions.guideBody: Structured extractions pull formatted data from conversations based on JSON schemas you define. Each extraction matches a schema and provides clean, validated data ready for downstream use.
extractions.emptyDescription:
Configure a JSON Schema in Settings > Extraction Schemas.
Define one, then process new messages through the enrichment pipeline.

observations.guideBody: Observations are insights derived from analyzing entity behavior across sessions — co-occurrence patterns, temporal sequences, and behavioral trends. They reveal how entities interact over time.
observations.emptyDescription: Observations are computed after enough messages have been processed. They will appear here once the background analysis completes.
